A wider table preserves those units and shortens rows at the cost of horizontal scrolling."},"designs":[{"widths":[168,75,98,124,254],"strategy":"Fit all five columns within 719px, protecting the compact audit fields while assigning the remaining space to package names and notes, accepting forced breaks in the longest units."},{"widths":[240,112,98,124,300],"strategy":"Use moderate horizontal scrolling to preserve the longest unbreakable units and give notes room to wrap, while keeping the table relatively compact."},{"widths":[412,112,98,124,489],"strategy":"Use a wide reference layout that keeps every cell on one line, making individual records easy to scan once the reader scrolls to the relevant columns."}]}
